description: LOOKUP(source, column, condition) returns one column of the first row of an explicit table, in the table's key order, on which the condition holds, and blank when no row does (ADR-0016, ADR-0020). In place of the column COUNT, SUM, MIN or MAX may stand over an expression of the source's columns, and the answer is what the same function gives over the same values inside one document: blanks skipped, exact values exact, numbers added one by one in key order, and an exact sum failing only when the total does not fit (ADR-0046). Inside the condition a bare name is a column of the source and THIS.name a variable of the document; a row on which the condition stops with an error does not match. An equality of one column with an expression of the document alone is the shape an index serves (ADR-0036); every other condition runs as a statement; both answer the same.

a matched blank is blank
a text column

FALSE matches nothing

cases.name: a row on which the condition errors does not match

cases.name: money compares with a decimal by its amount

a currency mismatch is an error on every row, so nothing matches
a blank number variable reads as 0
a lookup inside IFERROR
a blank lookup under ISBLANK
